description: This Java class implements a trie data structure for representing JsonFieldSelectors as a prefix tree, facilitating traversal and manipulation of JSON pointer paths within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorTrie
classes.description: A package-private, non-thread-safe trie structure for efficiently representing collections of JSON pointer paths.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a trie from a collection of JsonPointers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JsonPointer path to the trie.

methods.name: addJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: Recursively adds a path represented by an iterator of JsonKeys to the trie.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trie has any children.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of keys of the children nodes.

methods.name: descend
methods.description: Retrieves a child trie for a given JsonKey, or returns an empty trie if none exists.
